definition: One entry of a vector: the number in one position of the list.
Anything you can add to another of its kind and scale by a number, and still get the same kind of thing.
An ordinary single number, used to stretch, shrink or flip a vector.
Scale some vectors, then add them: a·u + b·v.
All the vectors you can reach with linear combinations of a set of vectors.
A collection where adding and scaling never take you outside it, and the usual rules hold.
